Every implementer (GlTextureBase, D3DTexture2D, D3DCubeTexture, D3DVolumeTexture) makes this device-bind the texture for use: GlTextureBase.method63 tracks a per-slot 'currently enabled GL target' array on the render device and issues glEnable/glBindTexture; the D3D implementations call the device's own bind-tracking helper (method3956/3954/3959) passing `this`. The only real call site (NativeRenderer.method3850, a 'set current bound renderable' helper) always passes the literal `(-30).toByte()`. Every implementation gates a secondary dead branch on `i > -21`/`i >= -21` (GlTextureBase nulls its own device reference; D3DTexture2D calls method64(null,39); D3DCubeTexture/D3DVolumeTexture call method2314) -- since -30 is never > -21, these are opaque-predicate dead branches consistent with the codebase's obfuscation style, never triggered in practice.

Abstract. `class209` is an opaque marker object (UnusedToStringStub has no fields, only a `toString()` that always throws) used purely for reference-equality comparisons -- effectively a hand-rolled 2-value enum. The two singletons ever passed are `PlayerSequenceSelector.aClass209_1212` and `FrameBufferObject.aClass209_4874`. GlTextureBase's override stores it and, if changed, re-applies glTexParameteri wrap/filter state: `PlayerSequenceSelector`'s singleton selects GL_LINEAR/GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR, the other selects GL_NEAREST/GL_NEAREST_MIPMAP_NEAREST -- i.e. this is a bilinear-vs-point texture filtering mode toggle (FrameBufferObject's token = point filtering for render-target textures, PlayerSequenceSelector's token = linear filtering for normal textures). Confirmed independently by D3dRenderDevice.Companion.method3952 which maps the same two singletons to D3D texture-filter constants (2 vs 1). The trailing `i: Int` is a confirmed decoy: every real call site (AnimatedModelRenderer.kt, GlFontTextured.kt) passes the literal `-22095`, and GlTextureBase/D3DBaseTexture's overrides only mutate unrelated state (null out aTextureFormatInfo_5084, or recurse into `method64(null, -80)`) when `i != -22095` -- a dead opaque-predicate branch.
